title: Majority Element II
description:
Given an integer array of size n, find all elements that appear more than ⌊ n/3 ⌋ times.
 
Example 1:

Input: nums = [3,2,3]
Output: [3]

Example 2:

Input: nums = [1]
Output: [1]

Example 3:

Input: nums = [1,2]
Output: [1,2]

 
Constraints:

1 <= nums.length <= 5 * 104
-109 <= nums[i] <= 109

 
Follow up: Could you solve the problem in linear time and in O(1) space?

check_function:
def check(candidate):
    assert sorted(candidate([3,2,3])) == [3]
    assert sorted(candidate([1])) == [1]
    assert sorted(candidate([1,2])) == [1,2]
    assert sorted(candidate([1,1,1,3,3,2,2,2])) == [1,2]
    assert sorted(candidate([2,2,9,3,9,3,9,3,9,3,9,3,9])) == [3,9]
    assert sorted(candidate([4,4,4,5,6,7,8])) == [4]
    assert sorted(candidate([0,0,0])) == [0]
    assert sorted(candidate([-1,-1,-1,0,1,2,3])) == [-1]
    assert sorted(candidate([1,2,3,4,5,6])) == []
    assert sorted(candidate([2,1,1,3,1,4,5,6])) == [1]
